name: manga-dl
description: a manga downloader and manga reader, use to your content

paragraphs: Live Web App & PWA: A modern manga, manhwa, and web novel reading ecosystem spanning Web (PWA), native Android, native Windows, and native Linux. Free, open-source alternative to Tachiyomi / Mihon with 50+ built-in scrapers, ad-free offline CBZ/EPUB downloads, and multi-tracker synchronization.
features: 500+ sources: Tachiyomi-compatible extension engine. Install, update, or disable extensions from the Keiyoushi index. Built-in providers include MangaDex, MangaKatana, Asura Scans, Bato.to, NovelBin, and 50+ manga and…
4 reading modes: LTR pager, RTL pager, webtoon scroll, vertical pager. Dual-page spread, tap zones, crop borders, webtoon padding, and image filters (brightness, contrast, grayscale, invert, sepia).
Local library: CBZ, ZIP, and EPUB import. Batch select with download, delete, and move-to-category. Dynamic grid columns, 8 filter modes, custom categories.
Tracking: AniList, MAL, Kitsu, MangaUpdates, Shikimori, Bangumi. Syncs status, score, chapters read, and dates.
History: Cloud-synced reading history with date filters (today, week, month).
